verification.note: Chapter 1 (The Living World) is sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Botany Fastrack, book p.3 (VSAQ 1 of 9), which prints the question and a model answer but no star ranks and no year citations. Only one source book is held for botany — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand is physics-only and no botany board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the board-paper back-test are both structurally impossible for this chapter; 'not checked' here means exactly that, never 'checked and clean'. The mark split is a claim until a TS IPE teacher confirms it; the question itself is sourced, not invented. BOOK ERROR: the book prints 'International code for Botanical Nomenclature'; the standard expansion uses 'of' — International Code of Botanical Nomenclature — and the card writes that.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The full form

lines.text: ICBN — International Code of Botanical Nomenclature

steps.why: The question asks only for the full form, so the expansion is the whole answer. The book prints 'International code for Botanical Nomenclature' — the standard name uses 'of', not 'for': International Code of Botanical Nomenclature.
common_mistakes: Writing 'International Council' or 'Indian Code'. The I stands for International and the C for Code.
Writing 'Biological' for the B. In ICBN the B is Botanical — this code is for plant names.
steps.memory_tip: Read the letters in order: I-C-B-N = International Code of Botanical Nomenclature.
steps.margin_note: One boxed line is the full answer. Start each word with a capital letter.

steps.label: What the code is
lines: It is the agreed set of rules for giving
steps.why: One extra line showing what the code does makes the answer complete, and it costs only a few seconds.
common_mistakes: Spending time on the history of the code. The 2-mark question does not ask for it.
steps.memory_tip: A code is a set of rules — ICBN is the rule book for plant names.
steps.margin_note: Optional line. Write it only if time allows.

insider_note: Full-form questions are checked word by word — a wrong middle word such as 'Council' or 'for' can cost the mark.
